# HomeAudienceDoorsNL 900x700 scroll check races display=swap font reflow

Design authority: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:205-237` (authored in `#20971`, asserting snap-aligned viewport framing at `900×700`).

Owned immediately (`@neo-gemini-julia`) to unblock red CI across open engine PRs (`#21298`, `#21300`); not offered as `good first issue` / `help wanted`.

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:205` began failing intermittently on CI runs rebased onto `d254125da4` (`#21293`, merged `2026-11-18 00:48Z`), blocking `e2e-engine` on `#21298` (3 runs, shard 7/15) and `#21300` (1 run, shard 1/2), and reproducing deterministically under cold-cache web-font timing locally. Promoted from `@neo-opus-grace`'s defect-note `f3a53f65` and `[ci-triage]` DM `ebe91936`.

## The Problem

1. **Pre-swap vs post-swap line wrap in Hero `h3` shifts `HeroContainer` height by `32 px`:** Commit `d254125da4` (`#21293`) changed `--core-fontfamily-sans` in `resources/css/theme-neo-{dark,light}/Global.css` from `'Source Sans 3'` to `'Source Sans 3', sans-serif`.
2. In `apps/portal/index.html:181`, Google Fonts loads `Source Sans 3` with `&display=swap`. At `900×700`, before the `fonts.gstatic.com` `woff2` finishes arriving (`~85–165 ms`), `.neo-h3` renders in fallback `sans-serif` across **4 lines** (`HeroContainer` height = `692 px`), whereas once `Source Sans 3` swaps in it wraps cleanly to **3 lines** (`HeroContainer` height = `660 px`).
3. `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:219` awaits only `.portal-home-parts-audiencedoors h2` text and immediately calls `scrollHomeToReference(page, app, home.id, 'home-audience-doors', doors.id)`, which runs `DomAccess.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'})` (`src/main/DomAccess.mjs:1389`). Smooth scrolling targets the pre-swap `scrollTop = 692`; when `Source Sans 3` swaps in mid-scroll, `HeroContainer` shrinks by `32 px`, leaving `home.scrollTop` at `692` instead of `660` (`doorsRect.top - scrollerRect.top = -32 px`), so `waitForStageTop`'s `Math.abs(rect.top - scrollerRect.top) <= 4` times out at 10 s.
4. Verified directly against `apps/portal/index.html#/home` at `900×700` with a simulated `250 ms` `gstatic.com` font delay:
   - Without waiting for stylesheets/fonts: `PRE-FONT: { heroH: 692, doorsH: 642 } -> POST-FONT: { scrollTop: 692, heroH: 660, doorsTop: 26, scrollerTop: 58, diff: -32 }`.
   - With `link[rel="stylesheet"]` + `document.fonts.ready`: `{ scrollTop: 660, diff: 0 }`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:30-76` defines `waitForStageTop` and `scrollHomeToReference`.
- Portal injects theme and home part `<link rel="stylesheet">` tags dynamically as Neo classes mount, and loads `Source Sans 3` / `Source Code Pro` / `Source Serif 4` via `fonts.googleapis.com` (`apps/portal/index.html:181`).
- Checking `Math.abs(rect.top - scrollerRect.top) <= 4` in `waitForStageTop` is an intentional geometry contract (proving snap alignment without underflow under the header); only the precondition before starting `smooth` scroll was missing.

## The Fix

1. Add `waitForHomeStylesAndFonts(page)` in `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` to poll until Portal Home's `body` font includes `Source Sans 3`, all injected `<link rel="stylesheet">` elements have loaded (`Boolean(link.sheet)`), and `await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready)` settles.
2. Await `waitForHomeStylesAndFonts(page)` at the top of `scrollHomeToReference(page, app, homeId, reference, targetId)` before invoking `app.callMethod(homeId, 'scrollToPart', [reference])`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `scrollHomeToReference` in `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` waits for Portal Home's injected `<link rel="stylesheet">` sheets and `document.fonts.ready` before starting smooth scroll.
- [ ] `npx playwright test --config test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs --repeat-each=2` passes deterministically (`6 passed`) and holds `diff: 0` even when `fonts.gstatic.com` is delayed by `250 ms`.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `apps/portal/index.html` font loading (`display=swap`) or Home CSS (`AudienceDoors.css` / `Hero/Content.css`).
- Weakening `waitForStageTop`'s `<= 4 px` tolerance or adding arbitrary `waitForTimeout` sleeps.

## Avoided Traps

- **Loosening `waitForStageTop` tolerance (`<= 4` -> `<= 36`):** Would allow the Hero to remain scrolled `32 px` past `AudienceDoors` under real header clipping, masking real layout bugs.
- **Fixed `waitForTimeout(500)`:** Flaky under slower CI network latency to `fonts.gstatic.com`; polling `<link>.sheet` + `document.fonts.ready` synchronizes on the actual completion signal.
